basic_profile.bio: TechTrekker2021 is a 27-year-old tech enthusiast based in Seattle, WA. With a background in computer science and a budding career in IT support, they are passionate about building computers and staying updated with the latest tech trends. Although new to DIY projects, they find joy in learning through trial and error. In their free time, they enjoy exploring male fashion trends and are an avid fan of retro video games. Usually active online during late evenings, TechTrekker2021 is currently single and enjoys connecting with fellow tech aficionados.
